standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.npc: Good day to you young lady.
I'm happy that we have our water back, thanks for your help.

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.player: Well it's good to see you happy.

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.npc: Mostly happy, but young people have no respect for their elders, theres too many confusing newfangled magic carpets and snake charmers around these days. I remember when this used to be fields.
Well no admittedly it used to be sand, just like it is now, but let an old man have his grumble.
